method: Each of the 1891 remaining inventory rows was read and assigned an explicit decision. No sampling or wildcard default. Fifteen previously reviewed targets are carried forward without rewriting their decisions.
scope: Natural Chinese entry names only. No runtime additions, tier changes, sentence authorization, frequency measurement, or native input claims.

notation.=: Explicitly accept the already-read inventory name.
notation.@: Explicitly accept the already-read flag proper name; expand 旗: name into name and name旗. This does not assert nationhood.
